brief: The far side has no source that puts anybody on it in the morning, and two open cues are the same fault seen twice. c143 (#96): the punt runs at ~zero because jetty stands are ALL 17:30-03:00 against an eastOpen() close of 20.6, so nothing fits. c152 (#101, measured over 248 far-side retirements): the deck's far posts are 33 cells / 4.7 h at a hurry from EAST_GATE_A and their source releases nobody before sunDown-4, so arrivals sit at sunDown+1.8 median. #101's own conclusion, after trying the other lever: a far-end stay that clears by 03h needs an EARLIER far-side source, not better pricing. spawnEastAgent is the only source out there and it opens late. Give the far bank its own arrival source with a morning-side window - people who come to the church, the orchard, the towpath or the mill early - so the punt has a rider that fits and the deck's far posts can be occupied and cleared before the night. This is the third manager pass these two cues have survived; they are a brief now or a deletion.
successLooksLike: On a fine summer day the far bank has people on it before noon where HEAD has none - show the HEAD zero first, since that is the whole premise. The punt makes at least one crossing on a majority of fine days, counted over 10 seeds. And no more nights hold a dusk agent at 03:00 than HEAD's 4 of 40.
avoid: Do NOT re-price stayOn at the choice: #101 measured that and it takes far-post fits from 41 in 248 to 2, deleting #85's stay outright. Do not raise eastCap - its arrivals RETRACE their route, so a wider cap just means single file. Count WHEN, not just how often: a place 12 h of walking from its source is an evening place however well the offer is priced.
